skill.summary: Browse and summarize websites, extract content from URLs, search the web for information. Use when user asks to visit a website, get webpage content, search...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the web-browsing skill.

- Enables browsing and summarizing websites, extracting content from URLs, and searching the web for information.
- Provides tools for web search, direct URL content retrieval, and HTML content extraction.
- Includes guidelines and best practices for effective use.
- Outlines current limitations, including handling of dynamic sites and login-required pages.
